chunks: That within it are the graves of the Prophets, peace be upon them.

key_terms.رُوِيَ: it has been narrated or reported

ai.seo_question: What has been narrated about the presence of the graves of the Prophets عليهم السلام in that sacred place?
ai.summary: This report states that within that place are the graves of the Prophets عليهم السلام. In the context of the chapter on the reasons behind hajj, it indicates the sanctity and historical significance of the sacred site.
